title: The 90 Minute Rule That Explains Your Work Day
description:
Your brain does not work in straight lines. It moves in roughly ninety minute waves, and fighting them is why some days feel impossible.

Made with AI assistance.

#facts #science #psychology #education #learn

scenes.narration: Your brain does not work in straight lines. It moves in roughly ninety minute waves, and fighting them is why some days feel impossible.
During each wave focus climbs, holds, then drops. The drop is not laziness. It is a biological boundary.
Push through it and you get the worst version of your work: slow, error prone, and exhausting.
The fix is to plan in blocks that match the wave, then stop before the wall instead of after it.
Rest in that window needs to be real. Scrolling is not recovery, because it keeps the same circuits engaged.
Work with the wave instead of against it and you will finish more in six hours than you used to in ten.
